purpose: Targeted primary-source literature review informing OWAC roadmap v5; not an exhaustive bibliography or reproduction report.
interpretation_rules: Method summaries use the inspected paper/proceedings version, not an assumed updated camera-ready version.
Author-reported venue status is separate from a publisher-confirmed record.
All Cui entries have Ziteng Cui in the inspected author list; adjacent entries do not.
No code, benchmark, dataset download or reproduction was completed for this review.
No full-paper or exhaustive novelty review is claimed; inspected scope is recorded per entry.
OWAC physical-intelligence directions and experimental designs are hypotheses, not findings of the cited papers.
